'''Retrieval''' was a branch of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence's]] [[Counter-Intelligence]] department. Working closely with [[Security]], Retrieval was responsible for taking individuals targeted by Security as suspected infiltrators and proving their innocence or guilt. To do this, Retrieval would carry out a surveillance operation, interview family and friends, place [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]], and, in some cases, interrogate them. Suspects who were found innocent were freed with no stigma attached to them. Guilty suspects&mdash;or those whose innocence was not proven&mdash;were either imprisoned, turned into a double agent, or simply [[Death/Legends|killed]]. While Retrieval did not terminate suspects unless absolutely critical, they had no compunctions about doing so if the act meant saving the Alliance from being severely damaged by leaked information.
